literal_meaning: এই কূল - ওই কূল (this shore - that shore)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাথে বন্ধুত্ব করলে একুল-ওকুল লাভ হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Being friends with him will bring benefits in this life and the afterlife.
Think about this life and the next before making a decision.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of river shores, symbolizing the boundary between life and death in Bengali cultural expressions.
